_comment: Data ownership registry (DATA-01). Owned by DATA_GOVERNANCE; DATA_LINEAGE generates docs/engineering/DATA_MAP.md from it plus the schema and code (scripts/data-map.mjs); CODE_HYGIENE keeps exportsTriage honest. Every table, view and Storage bucket needs an owner (a registered agent call) and a purpose. Functions inherit the owner of the table they touch most unless listed under functions.

app_feedback.purpose: Fan suggestions and bug reports from the app; triaged in the Feedback desk.

app_runtime_config.purpose: Draft and published app switches, copy and catalogs (Publish to app).

athlete_birthdates.purpose: Private athlete birth dates that decide when money control passes to the athlete.

athlete_career_stats.purpose: Career stat lines shown on athlete profiles.

athlete_game_logs.purpose: Per-game stat lines shown on athlete profiles.

athlete_vouches.purpose: Vouches that move an athlete up the verification ladder.

challenge_admin_events.purpose: Immutable action/time/reason/detail admin record retained2years (latest switch retained); trusted profile deletion/support erasure may only null identity references. Arbitrary client mutation and truncation denied.

challenge_athlete_settings.purpose: The athlete's "Allow challenges on my workouts" (no row: on for adults, off for minors and unknown ages). No client access.

challenge_badges.purpose: Private, noncash "Challenge finisher" badge after "Did it!" on 3 workouts (CHAL-01 1a). No client access.

challenge_mutes.purpose: A recipient's mute of challenge invites from one sender or everyone (CHAL-01 1a). No client access.

challenge_nudges.purpose: Friend invites to try a workout, shown in Activity (CHAL-01 1a); dropped ones kept with delivered = false only for the limits; deleted after 30 days. No client access.

challenge_responses.purpose: One current preset per account per Train Like Me workout; rolling50distinct-workout limit held separately in challenge_response_quota so removal does not refund capacity. RPC-only.

challenge_sender_holds.purpose: Admin mute or suspend of one sender's challenge invites, with the reason (CHAL-01 1a nudge-abuse view). No client access.

cheer_polls.purpose: School-versus-school cheer matchups and their votes.

company_revenue_logs.purpose: One row per revenue event (donation, tip for Tapua'i, card fee, Vault, booster, Drip); the books are built from it.

crew_follows.purpose: Fans who joined an athlete's Crew.

crew_push_queue.purpose: Queued Crew notifications waiting to be sent.

custodial_accounts.purpose: One guardian-held money account per athlete, with handover rules.

custodial_withdrawals.purpose: Guardian or adult-athlete withdrawal requests and approvals.

disbursements.purpose: Payouts to family accounts (queued, paid, failed).

donation_thanks.purpose: Preset thank-you messages athletes send donors.

filmer_rewards.purpose: Filmer Aura rewards (cash column reserved, always Tapua'i-funded).

friend_request_log.purpose: Every friend request sent (PRIV-01), so the 20-a-day and 3-per-person-a-week limits cannot be reset by cancelling and asking again; admin request counts read it. No client access.

friendships.purpose: Two-way friend requests and friendships (PRIV-01); decides the "friends" audience on profiles. Written only through request_friend / respond_friend / remove_friend; a decline is kept 30 days so the requester cannot re-ask, and is never shown to them.

game_events.purpose: Per-play events the sideline scorer records.

games.purpose: Local match board: teams, scores, clock, status.

guardian_approval_requests.purpose: Under-16 requests for the guardian to approve or decline (going public, friend requests from anyone); one pending per change, 14 days. No client access; decided ones trimmed after 90 days.

guardian_consents.purpose: Signed guardian consent records (MINOR-01): form version and text hash, typed-name signature, relationship, permissions (public profile, payouts), revocation. Append-only; kept after account deletion for the period counsel sets (LEGAL row AA). No client access.

guardian_invite_attempts.purpose: Wrong guardian-code tries, so 8-character codes cannot be guessed (10 a day per account). No client access; trimmed after 2 days.

guardian_invites.purpose: Hashed one-time guardian codes a teen shares (48 hours, newest only, 5 a day). No client access; trimmed after 30 days by the desk's retention purge.

guardian_links.purpose: A teen's linked parent or guardian (MINOR-01): from the teen's invite code (counts once the teen confirms) or the admin-set guardian on record; at most two; either side ends it, and a block ends it. Supervision only, never control. No client access.

ledger_accounts.purpose: Chart of accounts for the books.

ledger_manual_entries.purpose: Hand-recorded journal entries (expenses, Stripe fees, refunds, payouts).

ledger_manual_lines.purpose: Debit and credit lines of recorded entries.

ledger_period_closes.purpose: Closed months with their totals fingerprint.

payee_verifications.purpose: Append-only record of how each payee was verified (VERIFY-02): Stripe identity and tax ID result, the school's parent-on-record confirmation, document reviews (document not kept), Stripe Identity for disputes; status, reviewer, reason. Never an SSN. No client access.

payout_flag_overrides.purpose: Two-admin requests to turn a payee's transfers on or off by hand (VERIFY-02): reason, requester, second-admin decision, 7-day expiry. No client access.

players.purpose: Athlete roster that fans tag and donate to.

profiles_public.purpose: Public-safe view of profiles for other accounts.

rallies.purpose: Donation goals for a named sports cost.

reel_hype_votes.purpose: Seki / Aura / Flex taps per Highlight per account.

reel_photos_feed.purpose: Feed view of story photos with Vault gating.

reel_reports.purpose: Reports on a Highlight and their reasons.

reel_tag_rejections.purpose: Each athlete-tag decline (PRIV-01 stage 2): the same athlete cannot be re-tagged on that clip, and after three declines that uploader cannot tag that athlete. Written by confirm_reel_player_tag, read by the tag trigger. No client access.

reel_views.purpose: Counted Highlight views (3 s rule, one per account per day).

reels.purpose: Highlights: clips and photo stories with their tags and counters.

reels_feed.purpose: Feed view of Highlights with Vault gating.

school_confirmers.purpose: School staff allowed to confirm athletes, with hashed link tokens.

schools_and_teams.purpose: High school and college catalog with crests and colours.

sport_configs.purpose: Scoring, periods and stat fields per sport.

spotlight_awards.purpose: Player of the Week / Month / Year awards.

stripe_webhook_events.purpose: Stripe events the webhook already processed (deduplication).

subscriber_requests.purpose: Requests to subscribe to an athlete's Vault.

supervision_events.purpose: What a teen and their linked guardian both see changing (MINOR-01): age added, links, consent, settings keys, approvals. Kept 365 days. No client access.

support_audit_events.purpose: Atomic selected-table change audit: server actor/time/role, operation, record reference, changed field names and per-entity hashes; no row values.

support_releases.purpose: Admin-registered bounded local package manifest; server reporting identity/time, unsigned integrity and schema/migration provenance.

support_reviews.purpose: Append-only occurrence-scoped dispositions, false-positive rationale and independent protected review.

support_signals.purpose: Append-only bounded fixed-code observations; server actor/time, distinct client and trusted sources. No raw error or personal payload.

telemetry_logs.purpose: App events: taps, dwell, errors, checkout latency.

tips.purpose: Donations (code name tips), with channel, Rally, tip for Tapua'i and covered fee.

user_blocks.purpose: Who blocked whom (PRIV-01). A blocked person sees a private-guest view, cannot request friendship, join the Crew or tag; they are not told. Admins see counts only.

challenge_response_quota.purpose: Private rolling24h distinct-workout response capacity per responder, independent of removed responses or deleted reels. Own export; expiry purge; profile erasure/deletion clears it. Privileged support erasure is an explicit reset exception.

beyond_settings.purpose: Last contribution-switch administrator/reason/time; sole live enable remains published.highlights.beyondGameEnabled, defaultfalse. RPC-only.

beyond_posts.purpose: Account-owned immutable revisioned category/caption/audience/review/rights-safety version-time and cleanup state. Pending private, approved exact audience, reported held immediately; erasure anonymizes while retaining cleanup mapping.

beyond_media.purpose: Exact private immutable user/post/media path, kind/mime/bytes/dimensions/attested video duration. One<=45sec50MiB video or<=3JPEG5MiB photos. This metadata is not content/person/rights verification. Mappings retained until actual Storage absence.

beyond_submission_quota.purpose: Server reservation UUID/time per canonical owner, durable5perrolling24h regardless of self-removal. Own export;35day write/admin retention; privileged support erasure is an exceptional reset.

beyond_reports.purpose: Reporter canonical UUID, post/reason/time for immediate distribution hold and protected review; own report export and erasure. Not a public popularity metric.

beyond_admin_events.purpose: Restricted reason/action/time audit for switch/review/retention/cleanup. Identity references null on account deletion; support erasure sanitizes corresponding reasons. Minimal retained action/time is not counsel-approved retention.

fan_zone_campaigns.purpose: Default-off testing-only fan award campaigns, approved tester audience, immutable rules/windows and free-ballot result revisions.

fan_zone_entries.purpose: Private fan-video drafts/revisions, server-reserved immutable storage paths, verified media metadata, review and withdrawal state. Private guardian_consent_id pins the current exact grant; no automatic historical guardian substitution.

fan_zone_consents.purpose: Immutable exact-entry assent/guardian permission/revocation receipts tied to scope/media revision and active confirmed supervision link.

fan_zone_ballots.purpose: One current versioned free ballot per canonical eligible profile/campaign, with restricted invalidation rationale.

fan_zone_requests.purpose: Caller/request/argument-bound ballot retry receipts, capped60/window and expired30days after vote close.

fan_zone_cases.purpose: Private bounded report/appeal/deletion cases with hashed reporter receipt secret/30day receipt access, actual removal completion and escalation.

fan_zone_audit.purpose: Immutable server actor/time Fan Zone configuration/review/consent/ballot/result/removal trace; restricted corrective access.

fan_zone_reflections.purpose: Voluntary private preset service reflection receipts, deletable by owner; no beneficiary detail or payment condition.

sport_quiz_settings.purpose: Default-paused/testing-only quiz switch with approved canonical-profile tester allowlist.

sport_quiz_questions.purpose: Human-reviewed sport question versions, draft/approved/archive/void state and stable issued answer/explanation.

sport_quiz_attempts.purpose: Own private timed30/90-second immutable question/result lifecycle per account UTC week; legacy untimed history remains historical. Active capability hash never exported.

sport_quiz_badges.purpose: Private noncash Trivia Explorer weekly completion, equal right/wrong; historical Sport Learner preserved. No Aura wallet, vote/payment value; erroneous content corrections. QUIZ-03: unique per (profile, label, period); sport explorer (5 facts), Family Challenger (week), Season Learner (10 rounds per quarter); opt-in visibility to own groups.

sport_quiz_audit.purpose: Authoritative quiz settings/content/correction history remains immutable. Own participant learning associations are erased only under protected history-erasure context; admin export redacts participant actor/question/attempt links and never exports answers.

sport_quiz_preferences.purpose: Optional default-off weekly invitations, sports/mix choice, versioned notice acceptance, once-weekly invitation claim and CAS history revision. No inferred interests or disability reason.

sport_quiz_exposures.purpose: Unique own account/question-family issuance history including ended/expired/void rounds; avoids repeats while retained. Removed by explicit learning-history erasure.

sport_quiz_week_guards.purpose: Minimal profile/week/spent/prune quota record for35days, disclosed after learning-history erasure; no question/answer/receipt/token. Account deletion cascades; retention never removes unexpired guard.

sport_quiz_requests.purpose: Private bounded caller/request/normalized-input exact mutation recovery and cancelled Start fence; no plaintext secret/prompt. Erasable learning receipts with expected-week protection.

sport_quiz_round_items.purpose: QUIZ-03 per-question items of a weekly round (position 1-5, issued/expires, private answer, status incl. per-item void). Own history only; erased with learning history.

sport_quiz_groups.purpose: QUIZ-03 family-challenge groups: preset name only, sport theme, current owner (hand-over on creator deletion), status. No search or listing; purged 35 days after closing.

sport_quiz_group_members.purpose: QUIZ-03 group membership (max 12, belong to at most 5); removed rows are a rejoin bar (creator, block or admin). Leaving deletes the row.

sport_quiz_group_codes.purpose: QUIZ-03 one SHA-256 hashed 8-character join code per group, 7 days; dies when the group is full, rotates on removal; purged on expiry by retention.

sport_quiz_group_join_attempts.purpose: QUIZ-03 join limits (10 wrong tries, 5 joins a day) and private refusal reasons for the admin case view; kept through history erasure so limits and evidence survive; purged after 35 days.

sport_quiz_group_sets.purpose: QUIZ-03 shared group-week question set drawn without reading member exposures; purged at week end + 35 days and when a group dissolves on erasure.

sport_quiz_group_cases.purpose: QUIZ-03 append-only group safety log: reports (fixed reason), audited admin case views, removals, block removals, hand-overs. Survives group purge; FK nulling only on account deletion.

sport_quiz_life_chapters.purpose: QUIZ-04 Life Playbook chapters (4 seeded closed, all 13+: Money Huddle, Savings Season, Scam Defense, Smart Plays): title, framing, position, admin open switch. Opens only with 5 approved items (one round); owner simplification 2026-10-15 (design §8).

sport_quiz_levels.purpose: QUIZ-04 highest trivia level reached per account (track overall) and per Life chapter; only goes up; removed only by history erasure or account deletion. Private to the account; admin sees level counts with cells under 10 hidden.

quiz_athlete_facts.purpose: QUIZ-05 athlete fun facts (minors' personal data at 13-17): the only place the athlete's words live (2-40 characters, server-filtered); status through guardian (under 16, MINOR-01 approval type fun_fact) and one-admin approval; cleared at once on withdrawal (athlete only), unlink or an under-13 block, deleted with the account; filled into fun-fact questions per viewer at read time where the fun_facts audience allows; never in the audit log; exported by quiz_fact_export. PROFILE / CUSTODIAL / MINOR_SAFETY review.

sport_quiz_question_stats.purpose: QUIZ-05 per question version: distinct responders, right, time-outs, flags (too easy, confusing, too long), difficulty and the auto-pause / restore / review state for Needs a look. Aggregates only; refreshed by a trigger when an answer or time-out commits.

sport_quiz_reports.purpose: QUIZ-05 question reports with fixed reasons (no free text), counted or why not; reporter id cleared at 90 days and rows deleted at 180 by quiz_admin_retention; erasure removes the reporter's own; admins see counts by reason only.

sport_quiz_imports.purpose: QUIZ-05 one row per real bulk import (admin, reason, row totals); dry runs write nothing. Read as the 30-day import count in the admin snapshot.

reels.purpose: Public Highlight videos (reels/<uid>/…) and photo-story photos (<uid>/stories/…).

game_highlights.purpose: Fallback bucket for Highlight uploads when reels is unavailable.

reel_vault.purpose: Private Vault clips, read only through short-lived signed URLs.

beyond_game.purpose: Private reviewed fan media only: immutable <auth-user>/<post>/<media>.jpg|mp4, reserved before upload, exact audience/actor/closure/block checks andSDK-requested60s signed URLs. Removed bytes inaccessible to users; current open admins have narrow read/delete cleanup access until confirmed physical deletion.

fan_zone.purpose: Private bounded fan MP4 revisions; owner inserts only server-reserved draft path, no overwrite/directread/signing. Authenticated revocable server proxy reads, sanitizes and completes tracked removal.

get_engineering_support_snapshot.use: Admin-only bounded reader used by Engineering Support desk.

challenge_expected_profile.use: Private helper binds the supplied canonical profile to the actual nonclosed authenticated caller; only counts permit a no-auth guest null.

challenge_redact_audit_identity.use: Private trusted deletion/erasure helper nulls identity references while preserving audit action/time/reason/detail.

challenge_on_profile_delete.use: Profile-deletion trigger invokes narrow identity redaction; no client call.

challenge_admin_profile.use: Private expected-actor matched nonclosed admin gate for all7 challenge admin RPCs.

beyond_enabled.use: Reads sole published contribution enable; disabled/missing meansfalse.

beyond_actor.use: Private current nonclosed canonical profile and supplied expected actor match; only selected publicreads allow unauthenticated guestnull.

beyond_owner_open.use: Determines owner submission eligibility and closure/age status.

beyond_can_view.use: Private exact owner/admin/guardian or accepted approved audience check with current blocks/privacy/age and switch.

beyond_export_my_data.use: Bounded section/cursor own-data export for posts/reports/quota; server canonical actorbinding.

beyond_storage_guard.use: Storage write metadata/type/owner/path guard for immutable reserved media; no decoded content claim.

beyond_storage_allowed.use: Restrictive storage predicate protecting exact draft inserts, current accepted reads, no updates and removed cleanup admin access.

beyond_finalize.use: Exact existing reserved owned-file metadata validation and idempotent pending submission; actual media content review remains required.

beyond_remove.use: Own canonical-actor removal immediately hides distribution, queues physical cleanup without refunding quota.

beyond_report.use: Eligible current viewer concern immediately holds distribution and records reason once per reporter/post.

beyond_media_access.use: Actor-bound exact authorized post/file access, SDK-requested60s TTL; never removed or substituted/external paths.

admin_beyond_status.use: Protected contribution/dependency/switch-change status, pending and cleanup aggregates.

admin_beyond_set_enabled.use: Reasoned nonclosed admin-only sole published contribution switch, dependency-checked, defaultoff.

admin_beyond_posts.use: Bounded review state/cursor queue with protected reports/cleanup metadata.

admin_beyond_review.use: Reasoned approve/remove with immutable expected revision, accepted audience/owner/media/dependency recheck.

admin_beyond_cleanup_targets.use: Protected exact removedpost mapped private paths for real provider erasure, never SQL-only delete claim.

admin_beyond_cleanup_finish.use: Rechecks actual storage catalog absence; complete onlywhen every target absent, partial failures visible.

admin_beyond_retention.use: Reasoned admin24h draft expiry and35day quota purge; expired files remain mapped pending physical cleanup, no deployed schedule.

beyond_profile_erasure.use: Profile-deletion trigger nulls removed actor references and sanitizes affected event reasons while preserving cleanup mappings; server-only.

challenge_friends.use: Authenticated expected-actor bounded<=50 accepted-friend choice RPC for workout invitations; current blocks/closed/friendship rechecked, minimalprofile/name projection, no legacy unbound SDK read.

beyond_legacy_posts.use: Bounded <=24 minimal workout/service discovery cards, canonical expected actor including explicit guest null. Exact confirmed verified athlete/link; both athlete/uploader current photo audience/block/closure/teen consent, no media URL/full profile. Contribution switch independent.

fun_admin_campaign.use: Admin create/configure/testing-open/pause/close/finalize/recount; winners derived from valid free totals.

fun_entry.use: Caller-owned private reserve/edit/verified-submit/withdraw with immutable revision paths and server entry window.

fun_permission.use: Exact expected-scope assent/linked guardian grant/revoke; edit/stale form/link ending invalidates publication.

fun_vote.use: Atomic one free ballot/account/window; version CAS, caller/request/args retry binding, no-self vote and capped mutations.

fun_admin_entry.use: Admin normal eligibility/rights/safety decisions compare the exact reviewed scope atomically; explicit current-entry emergency suspension with private rationale; no winner selection.

fun_admin_ballot.use: Admin proven ballot invalidation with reason and recount-required audit.

fun_media_access.use: Caller-scoped exact revision read/verify/remove authorization before server private storage access.

fun_verify_media.use: Service-only sanitized digest/bytes/duration commit to still-authorized immutable draft; no client media assertion.

fun_complete_removal.use: Service-only actual object-absence completion across all tracked entry revisions/deletion cases.

fun_case.use: Bounded report/appeal/removal request with hashed secret; public report saturation cannot deny owner deletion.

fun_case_status.use: Secret-authorized unexpired minimal case status; no private target existence leak.

fun_admin_case.use: Admin case resolve/escalation with reason; completion only server-confirmed deletion.

fun_reflection.use: Own private voluntary preset service receipt create/delete, separate from badges/money.

fun_snapshot.use: Own/guardian plus enrolled-pilot campaign/candidate/result/curated-story projection; eligible is known-age, can_participate is caller enrollment capability; no tester list/voter identity exposure.

fun_admin_snapshot.use: Complete selected bounded campaign Data with independently paged cases/audit, exact campaign-bound timestamp/ID JSON cursors and defined counts; corrective identity scope.

fan_zone_private.upload_allowed.use: Private-schema Storage INSERT policy helper; schema usage denied to API roles, only policy-bound execute; owner editable reserved path/window and no existing object.

fun_page_time.use: Insert trigger ensures timestamp-page ordering without same-transaction skipped case/audit rows.

fun_immutable_record.use: Trigger protects exact consent/audit receipts against mutation/truncate; identity nulling handled for deletion.

fun_prune_receipts.use: Service-only explicit expiry cleanup for bounded ballot retry records; no scheduler or hosted execution established.

quiz_week.use: Internal authoritative UTC Monday start for one weekly assignment/badge.

quiz_actor.use: Internal canonical account/knownage/closed check; no client-supplied participant identity.

quiz_admin_actor.use: Internal protected quiz content/settings admin guard.

quiz_require_testing.use: Internal default-paused/tester allowlist/production-refusal guard for quiz participation.

quiz_guard_question.use: Trigger freezes issued question wording/answers; edits become new reviewed versions.

quiz_guard_audit.use: Trigger keeps trusted quiz audit immutable; allowed FK nulling on identity deletion.

quiz_snapshot.use: Read-only sanitized own v2 availability/preferences/week/attempt summary/pools/history revision at one server instant; never active prompt.

quiz_start.use: Atomic unseen reviewed family and30/90 deadline under account/settings locks; exact request/profile/week/notice/token-bound original-view recovery only before expiry.

quiz_preferences_dto.use: Internal own preference/notice/history-revision defaults and retained projection.

quiz_result_dto.use: Internal own terminal answer/explanation projection without active correct-answer leakage.

quiz_digest.use: Internal normalized request input SHA binding, never plaintext token persistence.

quiz_receipt_dto.use: Internal minimal owned exact receipt/terminal learning projection, never active question/token.

quiz_spend.use: Internal atomic disclosed35-day minimal weekly quota enforcement.
